View implementation coverage audit

Completed

  • Acquisition: Traffic channels, source / medium, and landing pages are included with comparison logic.
  • Content Performance: Most visited pages and landing pages by sessions are included.
  • Audience / Technical Breakdown: Device, country, and city breakdowns are included.
  • Core KPI Summary: All required GA4 KPI cards and comparison tables are present.
  • Comparison Logic: Day, 7-day, and 30-day comparisons all use current, previous, absolute change, and percentage change.
  • Shopify Commerce Diagnostics: Orders, revenue, AOV, units, customers, order quality, and product performance are wired into the global selector.

Partially Completed

  • GA4 Ecommerce Depth: Depth depends on the property’s ecommerce instrumentation. Optional GA4 commerce events only render when implemented upstream.
  • Customer Lifecycle Mix: New vs returning Shopify customers are estimated from the fetched reporting horizon, not full historical lifetime order data.
  • Cross-Source Bottleneck Logic: Traffic-to-commerce diagnostics are implemented from available GA4 and Shopify signals, but page-to-product attribution depends on naming and tracking quality.

Unavailable / Depends On Data

  • Exact Product-to-Page Attribution: Not guaranteed from the current setup because GA4 page data and Shopify order items are not joined by a stable shared product/page key.
